# Pin-exception register for scripts/audit-workflows.py (checks W11, W12).
#
# Every third-party action in .github/workflows/ must be pinned to a full 40-character commit
# SHA with a trailing version comment. An action that genuinely cannot be SHA-pinned gets a
# time-boxed entry here — never a permanent waiver.
#
# Format (one per line, all four fields required):
#
#   owner/repo@ref | owner=<github-handle> | expires=YYYY-MM-DD | reason=<why a SHA will not work>
#
# W11 fails an entry with no owner, no expiry, or a malformed date.
# W12 fails an entry whose expiry has passed — renew it with a fresh review or remove it.
#
# The register is intentionally EMPTY: all 11 distinct actions across the four workflows are
# SHA-pinned, and every pin is verified against its claimed tag. Keep it that way.
